review.notes: Engineering draft. Needs a Grade 5 Social Studies teacher to check outcomes wording against the KICD curriculum design, all Kiswahili text, rubric evidence lists, and the 50+ real-explanation test set per rubric.

title.en: Location, position and size of Kenya
title.sw: Mahali, nafasi na ukubwa wa Kenya
Sura kuu za nchi ya Kenya

skills.outcome: Identify the elements of a map (title, key, compass, scale) and explain why each is needed.

parentLabel.en: Knows the parts of a map and what they are for
parentLabel.sw: Anajua sehemu za ramani na kazi zake

skills.outcome: Use the compass to describe the direction of places on a map of Kenya.

parentLabel.en: Uses north, south, east and west on a map
parentLabel.sw: Anatumia kaskazini, kusini, mashariki na magharibi kwenye ramani

skills.outcome: Use a simple linear scale to work out real distances between places.

parentLabel.en: Uses a map scale to work out real distances
parentLabel.sw: Anatumia kipimo cha ramani kupata umbali halisi

skills.outcome: Locate the main mountains of Kenya and explain how height affects climate.

parentLabel.en: Finds Kenya's mountains and knows why they are cooler
parentLabel.sw: Anapata milima ya Kenya na anajua kwa nini kuna baridi huko

skills.outcome: Locate the main lakes of Kenya and the Great Rift Valley, and explain how the lakes formed in the valley.

parentLabel.en: Finds Kenya's lakes and the Rift Valley
parentLabel.sw: Anapata maziwa ya Kenya na Bonde la Ufa

skills.outcome: Locate the main rivers and the coast of Kenya and explain why people settle near water bodies.

parentLabel.en: Finds rivers and the coast and knows why people live near water
parentLabel.sw: Anapata mito na pwani na anajua kwa nini watu huishi karibu na maji

facts.en: Mount Kenya is the highest mountain in Kenya, about 5,199 metres high.
facts.sw: Mlima Kenya ndio mlima mrefu zaidi nchini Kenya, wenye urefu wa takriban mita 5,199.

facts.en: Its peaks are so high and cold that there is ice near the top, even though it is close to the Equator.
facts.sw: Vilele vyake viko juu sana na kuna baridi kiasi kwamba kuna barafu karibu na kilele, ingawa uko karibu na Ikweta.

facts.en: Mount Elgon is on the border between Kenya and Uganda.
facts.sw: Mlima Elgon uko mpakani mwa Kenya na Uganda.

facts.en: Kilimanjaro can be seen from southern Kenya, but it is in Tanzania.
facts.sw: Kilimanjaro huonekana kutoka kusini mwa Kenya, lakini uko Tanzania.

facts.en: Lake Victoria is the largest lake in Africa. Kenya shares it with Uganda and Tanzania.
facts.sw: Ziwa Viktoria ndilo ziwa kubwa zaidi barani Afrika. Kenya inashiriki ziwa hili na Uganda na Tanzania.

facts.en: Lake Turkana lies in the Rift Valley in northern Kenya. It is the largest desert lake in the world.
facts.sw: Ziwa Turkana liko katika Bonde la Ufa kaskazini mwa Kenya. Ndilo ziwa kubwa zaidi la jangwani duniani.

facts.en: The Great Rift Valley runs from north to south through the middle of Kenya.
facts.sw: Bonde Kuu la Ufa linapita katikati ya Kenya kutoka kaskazini hadi kusini.

facts.en: Many lakes lie on the valley floor, such as Lake Turkana, Lake Baringo, Lake Nakuru and Lake Naivasha.
facts.sw: Maziwa mengi yako kwenye sakafu ya bonde, kama Ziwa Turkana, Ziwa Baringo, Ziwa Nakuru na Ziwa Naivasha.

facts.en: The Tana is the longest river in Kenya. It flows from the highlands into the Indian Ocean.
facts.sw: Mto Tana ndio mto mrefu zaidi nchini Kenya. Unatiririka kutoka nyanda za juu hadi Bahari Hindi.

facts.en: Kenya's coast faces the Indian Ocean. The coast is low, hot and humid.
facts.sw: Pwani ya Kenya inaelekea Bahari Hindi. Pwani iko chini, kuna joto na unyevu.

facts.en: Nairobi is the capital city of Kenya.
facts.sw: Nairobi ni mji mkuu wa Kenya.

facts.en: Mombasa is Kenya's main sea port, on the Indian Ocean.
facts.sw: Mombasa ndiyo bandari kuu ya Kenya, kwenye Bahari Hindi.

facts.en: Kisumu is a city on the shore of Lake Victoria.
facts.sw: Kisumu ni mji ulio ufukweni mwa Ziwa Viktoria.

intro.en: A storm has torn pieces off the explorer's map. Help put back the title, the key, the compass and the scale.
intro.sw: Dhoruba imerarua vipande vya ramani ya mvumbuzi. Saidia kurudisha kichwa, ufunguo, dira na kipimo.

prompt.en: Which part of a map tells you what the map is about?
prompt.sw: Sehemu ipi ya ramani inakuambia ramani inahusu nini?

explanation.en: The title tells you what the map shows, for example "Kenya: Physical Features".
explanation.sw: Kichwa kinakuambia ramani inaonyesha nini, kwa mfano "Kenya: Sura za Nchi".

prompt.en: On the map, a blue wavy line is a river. Where do you find out what the symbols mean?
prompt.sw: Kwenye ramani, mstari wa buluu uliopinda ni mto. Unapata wapi maana ya alama?

explanation.en: The key (also called the legend) lists every symbol and colour and says what it stands for.
explanation.sw: Ufunguo unaorodhesha kila alama na rangi na kueleza inasimamia nini.

prompt.en: Which part of the map shows you which way is north?
prompt.sw: Sehemu ipi ya ramani inakuonyesha upande wa kaskazini?

explanation.en: The compass (north arrow) shows north. From north you can find south, east and west.
explanation.sw: Dira (mshale wa kaskazini) inaonyesha kaskazini. Kutoka kaskazini unaweza kupata kusini, mashariki na magharibi.

prompt.en: The explorer's map has no key and no scale. Explain why it is hard to use.
prompt.sw: Ramani ya mvumbuzi haina ufunguo wala kipimo. Eleza kwa nini ni vigumu kuitumia.

criteria.description: Says that without a key you cannot tell what the symbols or colours mean.
Says that without a scale you cannot work out real distance or size.

text.en: Look at the little pictures on the map. How would you know what each one means?
text.sw: Angalia picha ndogo kwenye ramani. Utajuaje kila moja inamaanisha nini?

text.en: Think about a journey. How would you know how far apart two towns really are?
text.sw: Fikiria safari. Utajuaje miji miwili iko mbali kiasi gani kwa kweli?

exemplar.en: Without a key I cannot tell what the symbols and colours mean, and without a scale I cannot work out how far apart places really are.
exemplar.sw: Bila ufunguo siwezi kujua alama na rangi zinamaanisha nini, na bila kipimo siwezi kujua umbali halisi kati ya mahali.

prompt.en: Why do we need a key AND a scale on a map?
prompt.sw: Kwa nini tunahitaji ufunguo NA kipimo kwenye ramani?

text.en: The key explains symbols; the scale shows real distance
text.sw: Ufunguo unaeleza alama; kipimo kinaonyesha umbali halisi

text.en: They make the map look nice
They tell you the name of the map

explanation.en: The key tells us what symbols mean. The scale lets us work out real distances.
explanation.sw: Ufunguo unatuambia maana ya alama. Kipimo kinatusaidia kupata umbali halisi.

intro.en: You are in Nairobi. Use the compass on the map to guide the explorer to new places.
intro.sw: Uko Nairobi. Tumia dira kwenye ramani kumwongoza mvumbuzi hadi mahali papya.

prompt.en: In which direction from Nairobi is Mount Kenya?
prompt.sw: Mlima Kenya uko upande gani kutoka Nairobi?

explanation.en: Mount Kenya is above Nairobi on the map, towards the north arrow.
explanation.sw: Mlima Kenya uko juu ya Nairobi kwenye ramani, kuelekea mshale wa kaskazini.

prompt.en: Tap the city on the coast that is south-east of Nairobi.
prompt.sw: Gusa mji wa pwani ulio kusini-mashariki mwa Nairobi.

explanation.en: Mombasa is south-east of Nairobi, on the Indian Ocean coast.
explanation.sw: Mombasa iko kusini-mashariki mwa Nairobi, kwenye pwani ya Bahari Hindi.

prompt.en: Kisumu is on the shore of Lake Victoria. In which direction from Nairobi is it?
prompt.sw: Kisumu iko ufukweni mwa Ziwa Viktoria. Iko upande gani kutoka Nairobi?

explanation.en: Lake Victoria and Kisumu are to the left of Nairobi on the map, which is west.
explanation.sw: Ziwa Viktoria na Kisumu ziko kushoto mwa Nairobi kwenye ramani, yaani magharibi.

prompt.en: Explain why a map needs a compass.
prompt.sw: Eleza kwa nini ramani inahitaji dira.

criteria.description: Says the compass shows direction (north, south, east, west).
Says this helps you find places, describe where they are, or not get lost.

text.en: What does the arrow on the compass point to?
How does knowing north help a traveller?

exemplar.en: A compass shows which way is north, south, east and west, so we can find places and describe where they are.
exemplar.sw: Dira inaonyesha kaskazini, kusini, mashariki na magharibi, ili tuweze kupata mahali na kueleza yalipo.

prompt.en: What does a compass on a map help us do?
prompt.sw: Dira kwenye ramani inatusaidia kufanya nini?

text.en: Know directions so we can find places
Know how hot a place is
text.sw: Kujua mahali pana joto kiasi gani

text.en: Know how many people live there

explanation.en: A compass shows directions, which help us find places.
explanation.sw: Dira inaonyesha mwelekeo, ambao hutusaidia kupata mahali.

intro.en: The explorer needs to know how far each journey is. Use the scale to find out.
intro.sw: Mvumbuzi anahitaji kujua kila safari ni ya umbali gani. Tumia kipimo kujua.

prompt.en: On a map, 1 cm stands for 50 km. Nairobi and Nakuru are 3 cm apart. About how far apart are they really?
prompt.sw: Kwenye ramani, sm 1 inasimamia km 50. Nairobi na Nakuru ziko sm 3 mbali. Ziko umbali gani kwa kweli?

explanation.en: 3 cm x 50 km = 150 km.
explanation.sw: sm 3 x km 50 = km 150.

prompt.en: On the same map, Nairobi and Mombasa are 9 cm apart. About how far is that?
prompt.sw: Kwenye ramani hiyo hiyo, Nairobi na Mombasa ziko sm 9 mbali. Huo ni umbali gani?

explanation.en: 9 cm x 50 km = 450 km.
explanation.sw: sm 9 x km 50 = km 450.

prompt.en: Two towns are 2 cm apart on the map. Which is true?
prompt.sw: Miji miwili iko sm 2 mbali kwenye ramani. Lipi ni kweli?

text.en: They are 2 cm apart in real life
They are 100 km apart in real life
We cannot use the map to tell

explanation.en: Each centimetre stands for 50 km, so 2 cm stands for 100 km.
explanation.sw: Kila sentimita inasimamia km 50, kwa hiyo sm 2 inasimamia km 100.

prompt.en: Why do map makers use a scale instead of drawing places at their real size?
prompt.sw: Kwa nini watengenezaji wa ramani hutumia kipimo badala ya kuchora mahali kwa ukubwa wake halisi?

criteria.description: Says real places are far too big to draw at real size, so the map is made smaller.
Says the scale lets you work out the real distance.

text.en: Could Kenya fit on a piece of paper at its real size?
text.sw: Je, Kenya inaweza kutosha kwenye karatasi kwa ukubwa wake halisi?

text.en: What can you work out with the scale that you used in the last tasks?
text.sw: Ni nini unachoweza kupata kwa kipimo ulichotumia katika kazi zilizopita?

exemplar.en: Real places are much too big to fit on paper, so the map is drawn smaller and the scale tells us the real distance.
exemplar.sw: Mahali halisi ni pakubwa mno kutosha kwenye karatasi, kwa hiyo ramani huchorwa ndogo na kipimo hutuambia umbali halisi.

prompt.en: Why does a map have a scale?
prompt.sw: Kwa nini ramani ina kipimo?

text.en: Because the map is smaller than the real place, and the scale tells real distance
text.sw: Kwa sababu ramani ni ndogo kuliko mahali halisi, na kipimo kinaonyesha umbali halisi

text.en: To show which way is north

explanation.en: Maps are drawn smaller than real life; the scale converts map distance to real distance.
explanation.sw: Ramani huchorwa ndogo kuliko uhalisia; kipimo hubadilisha umbali wa ramani kuwa umbali halisi.

intro.en: The terrain is rising! Find Kenya's great mountains and discover why their tops are cold.
intro.sw: Ardhi inainuka! Tafuta milima mikubwa ya Kenya na ugundue kwa nini vilele vyake vina baridi.

prompt.en: Find and tap Mount Kenya.
prompt.sw: Tafuta na uguse Mlima Kenya.

explanation.en: Mount Kenya is in the central highlands, north of Nairobi.
explanation.sw: Mlima Kenya uko katika nyanda za juu za kati, kaskazini mwa Nairobi.

prompt.en: Which is the highest mountain in Kenya?
prompt.sw: Mlima upi ni mrefu zaidi nchini Kenya?

explanation.en: Kilimanjaro is higher, but it is in Tanzania. Mount Kenya is the highest mountain in Kenya.
explanation.sw: Kilimanjaro ni mrefu zaidi, lakini uko Tanzania. Mlima Kenya ndio mrefu zaidi nchini Kenya.

prompt.en: Find the mountain on the border with Uganda.
prompt.sw: Tafuta mlima ulio mpakani na Uganda.

explanation.en: Mount Elgon is in the west, on the Kenya-Uganda border.
explanation.sw: Mlima Elgon uko magharibi, mpakani mwa Kenya na Uganda.

prompt.en: Why is it cooler near the top of Mount Kenya than at the coast in Mombasa?
prompt.sw: Kwa nini kuna baridi zaidi karibu na kilele cha Mlima Kenya kuliko pwani Mombasa?

criteria.description: Refers to height or altitude: the mountain is high up / the higher you go.
Links height with lower temperature (cooler, colder, ice, snow).
Contrasts with the coast being low (near sea level) and hot or humid.

text.en: Look at the 3D map. What is different about the land at Mount Kenya and at Mombasa?
text.sw: Angalia ramani ya 3D. Ardhi ya Mlima Kenya na ya Mombasa ina tofauti gani?

text.en: What happens to the temperature as you climb higher up a mountain?
text.sw: Nini hutokea kwa joto unapopanda juu zaidi mlimani?

text.en: Is Mombasa high up or low down? What is the weather like there?
text.sw: Je, Mombasa iko juu au chini? Hali ya hewa ikoje huko?

exemplar.en: Mount Kenya is very high, and the higher you go the cooler it gets. Mombasa is low down at the coast, so it is hot.
exemplar.sw: Mlima Kenya uko juu sana, na kadiri unavyopanda juu ndivyo baridi inavyoongezeka. Mombasa iko chini pwani, kwa hiyo kuna joto.

prompt.en: Why is the top of Mount Kenya colder than Mombasa?
prompt.sw: Kwa nini kilele cha Mlima Kenya kina baridi kuliko Mombasa?

text.en: Because it is much higher above sea level
text.sw: Kwa sababu kiko juu sana kutoka usawa wa bahari

text.en: Because it is closer to the sun
text.sw: Kwa sababu kiko karibu zaidi na jua
Kwa sababu watu wengi wanaishi huko

explanation.en: The higher a place is above sea level, the cooler it is.
explanation.sw: Kadiri mahali palivyo juu kutoka usawa wa bahari, ndivyo palivyo na baridi zaidi.

title.en: Expedition: lakes and the Rift Valley
title.sw: Msafara: maziwa na Bonde la Ufa

intro.en: A giant crack runs through Kenya. Follow it and find the lakes that lie along it.
intro.sw: Ufa mkubwa unapita katikati ya Kenya. Ufuate na upate maziwa yaliyo kando yake.

prompt.en: Find the largest lake in Africa, which Kenya shares with Uganda and Tanzania.
prompt.sw: Tafuta ziwa kubwa zaidi barani Afrika, ambalo Kenya inashiriki na Uganda na Tanzania.

explanation.en: Lake Victoria is in the far west of Kenya.
explanation.sw: Ziwa Viktoria liko magharibi kabisa mwa Kenya.

prompt.en: Trace the Great Rift Valley. Tap it on the map.
prompt.sw: Fuata Bonde Kuu la Ufa. Liguse kwenye ramani.

explanation.en: The Rift Valley runs north to south through the middle of Kenya.
explanation.sw: Bonde la Ufa linapita kaskazini hadi kusini katikati ya Kenya.

prompt.en: Which large lake lies in the Rift Valley in the north of Kenya?
prompt.sw: Ziwa lipi kubwa liko katika Bonde la Ufa kaskazini mwa Kenya?

explanation.en: Lake Turkana lies in the Rift Valley in northern Kenya. Lake Victoria is not in the Rift Valley.
explanation.sw: Ziwa Turkana liko katika Bonde la Ufa kaskazini mwa Kenya. Ziwa Viktoria haliko katika Bonde la Ufa.

prompt.en: Many lakes lie on the floor of the Rift Valley. Explain why water collects there.
prompt.sw: Maziwa mengi yako kwenye sakafu ya Bonde la Ufa. Eleza kwa nini maji hukusanyika hapo.

criteria.description: Says the valley floor is lower than the land around it (a dip/depression).
Says rain or rivers flow down into it and the water collects.

text.en: Look at the valley in 3D. Is its floor higher or lower than the land beside it?
text.sw: Angalia bonde kwa 3D. Je, sakafu yake iko juu au chini kuliko ardhi iliyo kando yake?

text.en: Where does rainwater go when it falls on high land?
text.sw: Maji ya mvua huenda wapi yanaponyesha kwenye ardhi ya juu?

exemplar.en: The floor of the Rift Valley is lower than the land around it, so rain and rivers flow down into it and the water collects to form lakes.
exemplar.sw: Sakafu ya Bonde la Ufa iko chini kuliko ardhi inayoizunguka, kwa hiyo mvua na mito hutiririka ndani yake na maji hukusanyika kuunda maziwa.

prompt.en: Why are there lakes on the floor of the Rift Valley?
prompt.sw: Kwa nini kuna maziwa kwenye sakafu ya Bonde la Ufa?

text.en: The valley floor is low, so water flows in and collects
text.sw: Sakafu ya bonde iko chini, kwa hiyo maji hutiririka ndani na kukusanyika

text.en: The sea flows into the valley

explanation.en: Water flows downhill and collects in low places like the valley floor.
explanation.sw: Maji hutiririka kuteremka na kukusanyika mahali pa chini kama sakafu ya bonde.

intro.en: Follow Kenya's longest river all the way to the ocean.
intro.sw: Fuata mto mrefu zaidi wa Kenya hadi baharini.

prompt.en: Which is the longest river in Kenya?
prompt.sw: Mto upi ni mrefu zaidi nchini Kenya?

explanation.en: The Tana is Kenya's longest river. The Nile is longer but does not flow through Kenya.
explanation.sw: Tana ndio mto mrefu zaidi wa Kenya. Naili ni mrefu zaidi lakini haupiti Kenya.

prompt.en: Find and tap the River Tana.
prompt.sw: Tafuta na uguse Mto Tana.

explanation.en: The Tana flows east and south from the highlands to the Indian Ocean.
explanation.sw: Mto Tana unatiririka mashariki na kusini kutoka nyanda za juu hadi Bahari Hindi.

prompt.en: Where does the Tana end? Tap the coast.
prompt.sw: Mto Tana unaishia wapi? Gusa pwani.

explanation.en: The Tana flows into the Indian Ocean on Kenya's coast.
explanation.sw: Mto Tana unaingia Bahari Hindi kwenye pwani ya Kenya.

prompt.en: Many people live near Lake Victoria, the River Tana and the coast. Explain why.
prompt.sw: Watu wengi wanaishi karibu na Ziwa Viktoria, Mto Tana na pwani. Eleza kwa nini.

criteria.description: Names a use of the water: drinking, farming or irrigation, animals.
Names a way of earning a living: fishing, trade, a port, transport, tourism, jobs.

text.en: What do families and farmers need every day that a lake or river gives them?
text.sw: Familia na wakulima wanahitaji nini kila siku ambacho ziwa au mto huwapa?

text.en: What jobs can people do near a lake or the sea?
text.sw: Watu wanaweza kufanya kazi gani karibu na ziwa au bahari?

exemplar.en: People live near water because they need it for drinking and farming, and they can earn a living from fishing, trade at the port, and tourism.
exemplar.sw: Watu huishi karibu na maji kwa sababu wanayahitaji kwa kunywa na kilimo, na wanaweza kujipatia riziki kwa uvuvi, biashara bandarini na utalii.

prompt.en: Why do many people settle near lakes, rivers and the coast?
prompt.sw: Kwa nini watu wengi huishi karibu na maziwa, mito na pwani?

text.en: For water, farming, fishing and trade
text.sw: Kwa maji, kilimo, uvuvi na biashara

text.en: Because it is always cold there
text.sw: Kwa sababu huko kuna baridi kila wakati

text.en: Because there are no animals there

explanation.en: Water bodies give water for homes and farms, and jobs such as fishing and trade.
explanation.sw: Maji hutoa maji kwa nyumba na mashamba, na kazi kama uvuvi na biashara.
